hints.title: Monthly Country Aggregation Metrics
hints.text: Group transactions by calendar month and country, reporting total counts, approved counts, total amounts, and approved amounts.

hints.title: Conditional Sum over State Column
hints.text: Format trans_date to year-month. Use conditional sum to calculate approved transaction count and approved total amount.

hints.title: Monthly Transactions Query Blueprint
hints.text: select date_format(trans_date, "%Y-%m") as month, country, count(id) as trans_count, sum(case when state = "approved" then 1 else 0 end) as approved_count, sum(amount) as trans_total_amount, sum(case when state = "approved" then amount else 0 end) as approved_total_amount from Transactions group by month, country.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(trans_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
       country,
       COUNT(id) AS trans_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count,
       SUM(amount) AS trans_total_amount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'approved' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS approved_total_amount
FROM Transactions
GROUP BY month, country;
```

complexity.notes: Single group-by pass evaluating conditional sums runs in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separate queries for total and approved metrics require multi-table outer joins and repeated scans.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Conditional case expressions aggregate multiple metrics in a single grouped traversal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of DATE_FORMAT for year-month string and conditional SUM(CASE WHEN state = approved).

SELECT TO_CHAR(trans_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       country,
       COUNT(id) AS trans_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count,
       SUM(amount) AS trans_total_amount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'approved' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS approved_total_amount
FROM Transactions
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(trans_date, 'YYYY-MM'), country;

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def monthly_transactions(transactions: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    transactions['month'] = transactions['trans_date'].astype(str).str.slice(0, 7)
    transactions['approved_cnt'] = (transactions['state'] == 'approved').astype(int)
    transactions['approved_amt'] = transactions.apply(lambda r: r['amount'] if r['state'] == 'approved' else 0, axis=1)
    res = transactions.groupby(['month', 'country'], dropna=False).agg(
        trans_count=('id', 'count'),
        approved_count=('approved_cnt', 'sum'),
        trans_total_amount=('amount', 'sum'),
        approved_total_amount=('approved_amt', 'sum')
    ).reset_index()
    return res
solutions.approach: Pandas String Slice and Grouped Multi-Aggregation
